patterns: Recurring character + masterpiece hook keeps compounding: lexx_aura's third Malfoy clip ("This Ai video is absolutely amazing 🔥 / Malfoy is Hot Blooded / Seedance 2.5") hit 1.03M in 20 hours (Mon 14:36), after the Sunday Malfoy clip climbed to 89K. Same character, same 3-line caption, new situation
Halloween week is peaking: lexx_aura's 'Trick or treat 🎃' masterpiece film is at 1.98M and still growing; 4 nights left until Oct 31, so countdown framing has a short shelf life
Dragons in dark fantasy still win outside the watchlist: Xaroon_x 'Epic dragon battles, cinematic fire, and dark-fantasy action' 38.1K (Mon 06:41)

Monday's other watchlist hits were paid tool launches (Flova 1.5 at 11.4K and 10.8K, Strawberry 1.0 at 7.4K and 5.4K), all posted Mon 13:28-15:00 Amsterdam. Not a format to copy, but it confirms the early-afternoon slot

@phulskamp posted 13 originals in 48h, all under 260 views (best: Infernal Demon Queen 252). Posts went out 05:30-07:15 and 22:00 with long ALL-CAPS titles and em dashes; the shorter Mirror That Crawled Back post (Mon 10:38) got 12. Fewer posts, one per day in the 14:30-15:30 slot, with a hook line before the title

Prompt CTA in the first reply ('Prompt 👇', 'The prompt is in the comments 👇') is on every AI-video hit; Grok Imagine is named in only one outsider hit (MichaelGannotti 13.2K), so it is still an open lane
